authority: owner directive 2026-10-19 'Get Signals Fantasy IDP Fully Voting' (docs/owner/SIGNALS_IDP_VOTING_2026-10-19.md, release train 13)
frozenAt: the merge of this file to main; evaluation releases are defined against that merge time

A.role: comparison baseline and negative control NC1; never redefined

F.vote: for p in M_F in a tie group of size t starting at competition rank k: r_F(p) = mean(L^M[k-1 .. k+t-2]); vote = Hill_GLOBAL(r_F(p)) through the voting path's own pricing helper, fractional rank passed directly (never translate_position_rank); Signals-only rows withheld

N.promotable: only if admitted under admissionRules, then under the same gates plus E2 rank-space consistency and the information diagnostic
admissionRules: server observation reachable through an operation the shipped app itself issues
covers DT, DE, LB, CB and S at or above the family board floors
inputs are scoring and lineup settings only, no roster dependence (keyable by scoring_fingerprint); otherwise leagueKey-scoped and rejected
deterministic across two reads at least 120 s apart; changes only with a publication
S1 not falsified: family tops not within 5% of each other and normalised curves not within +/-5% at k = 12 and k = 24
a dynasty trade value, not a projection: an age/horizon gradient consistent with dynasty value, rookies priced, DYNASTY game type proven per endpoint
lineage established by observed code paths; the IDP half is not a FantasyCalc or KTC derivative
licence: the attestation scope covers canonical use, else owner decision 6

diagnosticOnly.G: F plus Signals-only rows interpolated between matched neighbours
diagnosticOnly.N0: bridge-null voter: the bridge's own within-family order and coverage, priced as A (negative control NC4)
diagnosticOnly.J: Draft Sharks IDP as reference (the information diagnostic)

candidate4CompletedTrades.reentry: a census of IDP NATIVE_COMPARABLE / VALIDATED_TRANSFORMABLE underlying trades in data/market_trades/underlying_trades.sqlite (Sharp cohort included) of at least 30 per family with concentration and Kish tooling, plus a validated IDP-scoring translator or multi-season accumulation

definitions.R_F: board rows at position F with canonicalSiteValues[bridgeSource] > 0
definitions.c(p): p's slot in family_ladder(F), ordered by (-v_beta, lower(pinned name key))
definitions.S_F: Signals phase-1 eligible set (a native value on the family board, the row held at position F)
definitions.sigma: Signals' order: competition ranks of the native value within the family
definitions.M_F: S_F intersect R_F; m = |M_F|; k_M(p) is p's competition rank within M_F
definitions.L^M: ascending list of c(q) for q in M_F
definitions.Hill_G: GLOBAL shared_market pricing through the voting path's own helper
definitions.rookieRule: Signals IDP rookie rows are withheld this round (rookie_unobservable_by_basis)
definitions.multiBridge: more than one bridge contributor withholds every Signals vote (family_positions_undefined_multi_bridge) and fires an alert
definitions.newlyPricedNote: a row priced in one build and unpriced in the other is counted as a 100% move (conservative) and also counted separately
definitions.correctedPanel: other sources on the row with appliedWeight > 0, not hampelDropped, contributedToBlend not False, numeric valueContribution; at least 2 required; unweighted median
definitions.scriptPanel: other sources on the row that are not hampelDropped with numeric valueContribution; at least 1 (the round-1 instrument, always printed)

evaluationReleases.R1: the first Signals IDP release with asOf after the merge of this preregistration, contentSha256 != baselineRelease, and at least minRankChangeShare of matched rows changing within-family rank against baselineRelease; otherwise wait for the next release
evaluationReleases.R2: the next release after R1 meeting the same rule against R1

engineering.criterion: every Signals vote in shared_market coordinates
tests: missing ladder, bad identity, unsupported family, stale source
duplicate Signals observations on a row
shadow wouldContribute differs from the promoted valueContribution
|b_F - b_N0| on the corrected panel; verifies coverage and permutation integrity under F; NOT evidence of valuation quality

empirical.criterion: watch-list entries within the row range widened by 15%
Hampel drops of the independent-level anchor (draftSharksIdp) caused by Signals in the elite and starter bands
total Hampel drops caused by Signals in other sources, as a share of the family's voting observations
every caused drop explained by its filter stamp
family share of the overall top 200 moves
IDP relative movement median, served configuration, newly priced rows counted
IDP relative movement p90, served configuration, newly priced rows counted
offense player rows moved (hard FAIL until the #1817 two-way fix is deployed)
per-family signed median of (vote - corrected-panel median) / corrected-panel median, at least 2 other voting sources
board-level per-family mean shift; absolute and relative movement by mechanism class
confidence transition matrix and unjustified-inflation attribution
independent fresh-context review, which must classify Signals' IDP horizon (dynasty vs seasonal)
completed trades: never presented as validation; INSUFFICIENT below the minimum

dispositions.panelDefects: measurement correction (corrected panel); the script-panel number is always printed; needs owner decision 4
dispositions.borrowedLevelBias: owner decision 1: (a) signed-bias gates not applicable to sources without a level, consequences gated instead (G4-X, G6-shift, confidence), or (b) G6b stays binding
dispositions.hillMisfitAndPickCoordinate: reported; repair belongs to the Hill and bridge owners
dispositions.dlHaircutFlips: owner decision 2: wait for the #1817 haircut finding or accept the flips explicitly; no new served haircut bound
dispositions.hampelKnockOn: gated by G4-X; the filter belongs to the outlier lane

negativeControls.control: seeded random within-family permutation of Signals' matched order, median over draws, panel held fixed
fully reversed within-family order, panel held fixed

negativeControlRule: each control must FAIL the check a revised or decomposed statistic is used for; if a control passes, that statistic is VOID for the round
negativeControlScope: NC2, NC3 and NC4 per family (void that family); NC1 at DB (voids every family); a control passes when |median| <= the statistic's threshold on at least minCell rows

premises.premise: haircut flips account for at least 80% of DL rows at or above the DL relative-movement p90 on the box board
the box-board N0 LB and DB floor on the corrected panel lies within [-6%, 0%]
IDP Show is zero-weight on the evaluation board

premiseRule: a falsified premise voids every disposition that depends on it

builds: leave-target-out with N0 in place of Signals
information.rule: POSITIVE when the with-Signals Spearman against the target beats both the without-Signals and the N0 build by at least spearmanMargin AND Draft Sharks sides with Signals on at least sideWithSignalsPositive of at least minDiscordantPairs pairs where Signals and the bridge disagree; NEGATIVE when both Spearman deltas are at most -spearmanMargin AND the side-with share is at most sideWithSignalsNegative; INSUFFICIENT below minMatchedRowsPerFamily or minDiscordantPairs; otherwise NEUTRAL.  An information metric, never an agreement penalty

privacy.watchListPublic: counts only, {entries, withinRange}, and only when entries >= 5
